summary.business_type: SaaS — free AI YouTube SEO tool (SoftwareApplication) with pSEO glossary
top_findings: ~6,400 of 8,328 /glossary/*-vs-* URLs return HTTP 500 (server bug), all listed in sitemap — sitemap is ~96% broken URLs
Blog JSON-LD unparseable on most new posts (unescaped HTML in JSON strings)
14 bulk-AI blog posts (7/27-7/30) contain fabricated 'research' claims; missing from sitemap
/pricing serves the dashboard app shell (noindex) — navigational intent mismatch
E-E-A-T vacuum: anonymous ownership, brand-only bylines, fabricated metrics, empty 'Trusted by' section, Gmail contact
quick_wins: Fix vs-page server bug or drop 8.3k vs-URLs from sitemap
Reconcile sitemap: remove 5 noindex pages, add 15 blog posts + 17 tools, add lastmod
Fix blog JSON-LD escaping + '2026 2026' title bug + duplicate canonicals

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Model robots.txt: 8 AI search bots allowed, GPTBot/CCBot blocked, sitemap declared
Valid sitemap, 0 duplicates, clean 308 redirects, real 404 statuses, HSTS preload + CSP
All page types fully server-rendered (no SPA shells for crawlers)

findings.title: Glossary X-vs-Y pages mass-fail with HTTP 500 (~6,400 URLs)
findings.description: 154/500 crawled pages 500, all /glossary/*-vs-*; body: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'slug'); 77% of vs-URLs broken; all in sitemap
findings.recommendation: Fix serverless lookup for missing term data; exclude vs-URLs from sitemap until fixed; 410 unbuildable pairs
